en: Colorized vintage view of a landscaped park leading to a monumental stone entrance built into a grassy mound. Above the arched doorway is an inscription reading "VLADISLAO VARNENS" flanked by heraldic shields. A tall column with a cross stands on top of the hill behind the structure, and two children are visible near the entrance. Flowerbeds and paths occupy the foreground.
